name: Flak lorry, 20 mm gun
about: Made by tools/battle-models (aa). Metres; x forward, y right, z up. A battle model: `part` says which part each point belongs to; `parts` are the parts (parent, pivot, axis of turning, way of sliding); `sockets` are named places for flash, smoke, fire and wake; `clips` move the parts. Turns: +t degrees about an axis carries p to p cos t + (axis x p) sin t + axis (axis . p)(1 - cos t), about the part's pivot. Paints: 0 upper, 1 upper2, 2 shade, 3 track, 4 rubber, 5 steel, 6 bright, 7 wood, 8 canvas, 9 glass, 10 black, 11 rust, 12 lamp, 13 white, 14 red, 15 yellow, 16 blue, 17 leather, 18 torn, 19 rope, 20 cloth, 21 skin, 22 brass `mid`: the middle mesh, for about 40 to 140 m (~15,000 triangles): the near mesh thinned, small pieces gone, the far mesh's track band in place of the links, alike parts (road wheels) carrying the same mesh; its `part` numbers count the parts without the track links, as `far`'s do.

parts.name: vehicle
parts.note: on the ground under her middle; the game moves and turns this

parts.name: hull
parts.note: rocks on her springs: + nose up (clips also roll and bob her)

parts.name: steer_l
parts.note: a front wheel on its kingpin: + steers to the right

parts.name: steer_r
parts.note: a front wheel on its kingpin: + steers to the right

parts.name: tailboard
parts.note: the tailboard: + drops it (90 lies level, 178 hangs down)

parts.name: turret
parts.note: the gun's mount: trains all round, by hand: + to the right, clockwise seen from above; the game turns it

parts.name: gun
parts.note: lifts at the trunnions: + muzzle up, almost to the upright; the game lays it

parts.name: barrel
parts.note: jumps back along its own length at each round (metres)

sockets.name: step
sockets.note: behind the tailboard: where the men come down

sockets.name: hook
sockets.note: the towing hook: a gun's eye (her socket `tow`) goes on it

sockets.name: driver
sockets.note: the driver's place (left-hand drive): her cab is shut and its glass dark, so no man is shown in it; he bails out from here

sockets.name: rider.cab
sockets.note: the place beside the driver: not shown, as his

sockets.name: load
sockets.note: the middle of the floor: stores stand here

sockets.name: engine
sockets.note: the bonnet: smoke and the first fire

sockets.name: crew.gunner
sockets.note: the gunner, seated behind the gun: the top of his seat, 0.31 over the platform his boots are on; he turns with the mount

sockets.name: grip.gunner.r
sockets.note: his right hand: the handle of the wheel he lays her by (its middle)

sockets.name: grip.gunner.l
sockets.note: his left hand: the handle of the wheel he trains her by (its middle)

sockets.name: case
sockets.note: where the empty cases are thrown out, to her right

sockets.name: commander
sockets.note: the gun's commander stands here, by the boxes of rounds, watching the sky

sockets.name: crew.loader
sockets.note: a loader stands here on the gun's left, facing it: the magazine goes in at his thigh, he bends to it

sockets.name: crew.loader2
sockets.note: the second loader stands here, by the boxes of rounds, with the next magazines

sockets.name: ring
sockets.note: the foot of the gun's mount

sockets.name: fire.3
sockets.note: at the gun: her ready rounds burn

start.about: the engine is started: she shudders, a gout of smoke from the exhaust

drive.about: under way: the hull's own motion (the game rolls the wheels, runs the tracks and moves her)

move_off.about: she moves off: the nose lifts as the tracks bite, and settles

stop.about: she brakes: start it as the brakes go on. The nose dips and stays down while she slows; she is at rest `rest` seconds in (play it faster or slower to fit), and the nose comes back up, a little over, and settles

fire.about: a burst from her automatic gun: 6 rounds, the barrel jumping to each

fire.rock.about: the hull's answer to the shot, for a gun trained ahead: she is thrown back on her springs, the nose lifts about a degree, and she settles in a second. With the turret trained off, turn this about the turret's bearing or play it weaker

knocked_out.about: knocked out: struck at 0.0, hatches thrown open as the crew bail out, the gun droops, smoke, then fire at the engine; holds its last pose (follow with `burn`)

burn.about: burning: fire at the engine and out of her hatches, black smoke (loop after knocked_out or brew_up)

turret.what: trained by the game: + to the right (clockwise from above)

gun.what: laid by the game inside its limits: + muzzle up

steer.what: the game steers the front wheels inside their lock: + to the right

camouflage.how: `blend` (point by point, 0 to 100) is how far a point of the coat is into the second coat colour: camouflage blotches. Fill `upper` with the nation's paint and `upper2` with its paint2; a nation with one colour only: fill `upper2` with `upper`.

running.how: turn each wheel by (distance run on its side) / radius, in radians; play tracks.left and tracks.right at (speed of that side) / stride * long

units: the light flak that rolls with every other army's columns
